This claim excludes production Flatpak sandbox readiness, host integration readiness, reproducible builds, and universal GPU availability.

output.claim_status: Locally supported; live execution and external runner controls remain unverified.
output.summary: The supplied files implement the required bounded Flatpak builder/install/runtime path and protected manual GPU matrix without a material correctness or safety defect.

No GPU dispatch results prove actual VAAPI/NVENC output on provisioned runners.
CLI/profile definitions and repository environment-protection settings are outside the supplied evidence.
supported_claims: Local proof: ci.yml invokes the Flatpak-builder action, installs media-studio.flatpak, and runs the packaged command through Flatpak with bounded timeouts.
Local proof: the CI manifest uses the current checkout, runtime 25.08, and the required filesystem permission; packaging parity checks are present.
Local proof: gpu.yml is workflow_dispatch-only, restricted to the upstream main ref, and uses two self-hosted backend-labeled matrix entries.
Local proof: hardware-smoke.sh checks exact encoders, disables fallback, verifies output decoding, and requires HARDWARE_USED, RESULT=verified, and no HARDWARE_FALLBACK marker.
Local proof: gpu-runners.md specifies labels, device nodes, encoder requirements, and runner-user access requirements.
residual_risks: The intentional --privileged builder and --filesystem=host permissions remain experimental claim-boundary risks.
Mutable action references and the required runtime branch must not be presented as reproducibility guarantees.
GPU proof depends on correctly configured self-hosted labels, device access, and gpu-hardware environment controls.
